title: AIA$^{2}$: Attribute-Agnostic Imbalance Augmentation for Subgroup Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2608.30297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attributes describing data content and context can induce diverse imbalance patterns that go beyond label imbalance alone. However, existing studies primarily address label imbalance while overlooking data attributes, such as topics and demographics, which can induce meaningful subgroup structure while causing model degradation on underrepresented subgroups. We propose Attribute-Agnostic Imbalance Augmentation (AIA$^{2}$), a framework for improving model robustness under varying subgroup imbalances without explicit subgroup annotations. AIA$^{2}$ automatically discovers varying imbalances via latent semantic distributions, obtains slices with both learning difficulty and subgroup imbalance deficits, and deploys a large language model (LLM) for subgroup-aware imbalance augmentation. translated_title: AIA²：面向子群体鲁棒性的属性无关不平衡增强
translated_abstract: 描述数据内容和上下文的属性会引发多样化的不平衡模式，其范畴超出了单纯的标签不平衡。然而，现有研究主要针对标签不平衡，而忽视了数据属性（如主题和人口统计学特征），这些属性能够形成有意义的子群体结构，同时导致模型在代表性不足的子群体上性能退化。我们提出了属性无关不平衡增强（AIA²），这是一个无需显式子群体标注即可提升模型在不同子群体不平衡下鲁棒性的框架。AIA² 通过潜在语义分布自动发现各类不平衡，获取同时存在学习困难和子群体不平衡缺陷的数据切片，并利用大语言模型（LLM）进行子群体感知的不平衡增强。我们在5个具有丰富领域及属性值的流行语料库上评估了AIA²，涵盖社会问题和多样化主题。结果显示模型性能得到提升。
tldr: 提出AIA²框架，通过潜在语义分布自动发现由数据属性引起的不平衡，并借助大语言模型进行子群体感知的数据增强，在无需子群体标注的情况下提升模型在代表性不足子群体上的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: AIA² automatically discovers attribute-induced subgroup imbalances via latent semantic distributions and leverages LLMs for subgroup-aware augmentation, improving model robustness on underrepresented subgroups without requiring explicit subgroup annotations.
